question: Should CodexBar accept ai& as a permanently maintained core provider once successful funded-account behavior is demonstrated?
rationale: The implementation follows existing architecture, but adding a third-party provider expands the permanent compatibility, documentation, and support surface, and current related discussions do not establish an automatic admission policy.

options.title: Sponsor after proof
options.body: Accept ai& as a default-disabled core provider after successful funded-account proof is added and the release-owned changelog edit is removed.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Do not merge the provider if its expected user value does not justify an ongoing core maintenance commitment.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after proof
recommendation.body: Accept ai& as a default-disabled core provider after successful funded-account proof is added and the release-owned changelog edit is removed.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available decision owner for permanent provider scope and release support.
